integrity: The finite certificates are field-exact; the unbounded range is proved analytically by a Legendre Bernstein inequality. Historical publication priority is qualified; no independent mathematical certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the 30-vertex icosidodecahedron and exact-degree evaluation, not arbitrary orbits, least singular values, multiband interpolation, or numerical stability. Finite exact computations are supplied as part of the proof. Older icosahedral symmetry tables may contain equivalent partial results.
title: Exact all-degree harmonic interpolation ranks on the icosidodecahedron
